exception_list.root_cause: Razorpay charged 2.0% MDR but ERP expected 1.8%. Delta of ₹4.12 on captured amount ₹2,060.00.
exception_list.recommended_action: Update ERP MDR configuration from 1.8% to 2.0% for this MID.

exception_list.root_cause: Fee variance: bank deducted ₹89.40 (2.0%) vs ERP expectation of ₹80.46 (1.8%) on ₹4,470.00.
exception_list.recommended_action: Reconcile MDR rate with Razorpay pricing sheet; update ERP template.

exception_list.root_cause: Transaction captured at 23:55 IST crossed the T+1 settlement cutoff. Bank settled at T+2 instead.
exception_list.recommended_action: No financial loss. Flag as timing delay; update SLA expectation for late-night captures.

exception_list.root_cause: Late capture (00:03 IST) pushed settlement to next business day cycle. Amount correct but date mismatched.
exception_list.recommended_action: Informational only — cash received within acceptable T+2 window.

exception_list.root_cause: 50% refund of ₹1,823.50 processed post-capture. Net settlement is capture minus MDR minus refund.
exception_list.recommended_action: Link refund ID to this transaction in ERP; close the loop.

exception_list.root_cause: Partial refund of ₹2,104.00 not reflected in ERP expected_settlement. Bank correctly netted.
exception_list.recommended_action: ERP needs refund journal entry; auto-close once refund_id is mapped.

exception_list.root_cause: International card method charged 3.5% MDR vs domestic 2.0% expectation in ERP.
exception_list.recommended_action: Tag payment method as international; apply correct rate in ERP.

exception_list.root_cause: AMEX surcharge: 2.5% charged vs standard 2.0%. ERP config doesn't distinguish card networks.
exception_list.recommended_action: Add network-level MDR tiers in ERP configuration.

exception_list.root_cause: Sunday batch: capture at 23:58 IST. No settlement cycle on Sunday; cash landed Monday T+1 (effective T+2).
exception_list.recommended_action: Expected behavior for weekend cutoffs. Auto-close with note.

exception_list.root_cause: Bank holiday delayed settlement by 1 additional day. Amount reconciles correctly.
exception_list.recommended_action: Calendar-aware reconciliation needed; no financial discrepancy.

exception_list.root_cause: Customer returned 1 of 3 items. 33% refund processed; net settlement reduced accordingly.
exception_list.recommended_action: Map refund to original order line items in ERP.

exception_list.root_cause: Goodwill refund of ₹500 issued post-settlement. Creates a negative adjustment in next cycle.
exception_list.recommended_action: Expect debit in next settlement batch; pre-book liability in ERP.

exception_list.root_cause: Promotional 0% MDR period ended mid-batch. First 3 txns at 0%, rest at 2%.
exception_list.recommended_action: Verify promo end date with Razorpay account manager; split-apply rates.

exception_list.root_cause: UPI transaction incorrectly charged 2% MDR; UPI MDR is 0% per RBI mandate for < ₹2000.
exception_list.recommended_action: Raise dispute with Razorpay for fee reversal on sub-₹2000 UPI txn.

exception_list.root_cause: Settlement file from HDFC received at 02:00 IST next day. Data delay, not payment delay.
exception_list.recommended_action: Reconciliation timing issue only; no action needed on cash.

exception_list.root_cause: RBI system maintenance window (23:00–01:00). NEFT batch delayed by 3 hours.
exception_list.recommended_action: Auto-close; systemic delay affects all PGs equally.

exception_list.root_cause: Split refund: ₹1,200 refunded to original method + ₹300 as store credit. Bank only shows ₹1,200.
exception_list.recommended_action: Store credit portion won't appear in bank; reconcile against internal wallet ledger.

exception_list.root_cause: Refund initiated but not yet processed by issuer bank. Status: pending.
exception_list.recommended_action: Re-check in T+3. If still pending, escalate to Razorpay support.

exception_list.root_cause: Wallet payment (PayTM) charged 1.5% vs expected 2.0%. Lower MDR for wallet methods.
exception_list.recommended_action: Update ERP to reflect method-specific MDR: wallet = 1.5%.

exception_list.root_cause: Corporate card surcharge of 2.25% applied. Standard card rate is 2.0%.
exception_list.recommended_action: Distinguish corporate vs consumer card BINs in MDR logic.

exception_list.root_cause: Cross-border settlement via SWIFT took T+3. Domestic expectation was T+1.
exception_list.recommended_action: Flag international settlements with extended SLA window.

exception_list.root_cause: Nodal bank batch processing delay due to high volume end-of-month.
exception_list.recommended_action: Expected EOM spike. Auto-close after T+2 confirmation.

exception_list.root_cause: Chargeback-initiated partial refund. Network reversed 60% of original amount.
exception_list.recommended_action: Update dispute status in chargeback tracker; book remaining 40% as revenue.

exception_list.root_cause: Multi-item order: 2 of 5 items returned. Pro-rata refund of 40% applied.
exception_list.recommended_action: Verify item-level return in warehouse system; sync with ERP.
